args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_file <- args[1]
metadata_file <- args[2]
result_file <- args[3]
count_file <- args[4]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts_df <- read.table(counts_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 3) stop("Count table must contain gene IDs and sample columns")
if (anyDuplicated(counts_df[[1]]) > 0) stop("Duplicate gene IDs in count table")
gene_ids <- counts_df[[1]]
count_mat_all <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat_all) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(count_mat_all) <- "integer"

meta <- read.delim(metadata_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE, quote = "")
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% names(meta))) stop(paste("Metadata missing columns:", paste(setdiff(required, names(meta)), collapse = ",")))
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$sample) & meta$sample != "", required, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[meta$condition %in% c("ASXL1", "Control") & meta$sex %in% c("M", "F"), , drop = FALSE]
if (anyDuplicated(meta$sample) > 0) stop("Duplicate sample IDs in metadata")
matched <- meta$sample[meta$sample %in% colnames(count_mat_all)]
if (length(matched) == 0) stop("No metadata samples match count columns")
meta <- meta[match(matched, meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
count_mat <- count_mat_all[, meta$sample, drop = FALSE]
if (!identical(colnames(count_mat), meta$sample)) stop("Sample order mismatch after matching")

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
meta$sex <- factor(meta$sex)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat, colData = meta, design = ~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"), alpha = 0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$padj), ])
res_df$geneID <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c("geneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(res_df, file = result_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

sig_count <- sum(!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05)
meta_lines <- c(
  paste("significant_padj_lt_0.05", sig_count, sep = "\t"),
  paste("deseq2_version", as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), sep = "\t"),
  paste("analysis_samples", ncol(count_mat), sep = "\t"),
  paste("excluded_count_columns", paste(setdiff(colnames(count_mat_all), meta$sample), collapse = ","), sep = "\t"),
  paste("design", "~ sex + condition", sep = "\t"),
  paste("contrast", "ASXL1_vs_Control", sep = "\t"),
  paste("results_alpha", "0.05", sep = "\t"),
  paste("apeglm_available", requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE), sep = "\t")
)
writeLines(meta_lines, con = count_file)
RSCRIPT

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_file <- args[1]
metadata_file <- args[2]
result_file <- args[3]
count_file <- args[4]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts_df <- read.table(counts_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 3) stop("Count table must contain gene IDs and sample columns")
if (anyDuplicated(counts_df[[1]]) > 0) stop("Duplicate gene IDs in count table")
gene_ids <- counts_df[[1]]
count_mat_all <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat_all) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(count_mat_all) <- "integer"

meta <- read.delim(metadata_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE, quote = "")
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% names(meta))) stop(paste("Metadata missing columns:", paste(setdiff(required, names(meta)), collapse = ",")))
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$sample) & meta$sample != "", required, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[meta$condition %in% c("ASXL1", "Control") & meta$sex %in% c("M", "F"), , drop = FALSE]
if (anyDuplicated(meta$sample) > 0) stop("Duplicate sample IDs in metadata")
matched <- meta$sample[meta$sample %in% colnames(count_mat_all)]
if (length(matched) == 0) stop("No metadata samples match count columns")
meta <- meta[match(matched, meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
count_mat <- count_mat_all[, meta$sample, drop = FALSE]
if (!identical(colnames(count_mat), meta$sample)) stop("Sample order mismatch after matching")

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
meta$sex <- factor(meta$sex)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat, colData = meta, design = ~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"), alpha = 0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$padj), ])
res_df$geneID <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c("geneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(res_df, file = result_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

sig_count <- sum(!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05)
meta_lines <- c(
  paste("significant_padj_lt_0.05", sig_count, sep = "\t"),
  paste("deseq2_version", as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), sep = "\t"),
  paste("analysis_samples", ncol(count_mat), sep = "\t"),
  paste("excluded_count_columns", paste(setdiff(colnames(count_mat_all), meta$sample), collapse = ","), sep = "\t"),
  paste("design", "~ sex + condition", sep = "\t"),
  paste("contrast", "ASXL1_vs_Control", sep = "\t"),
  paste("results_alpha", "0.05", sep = "\t"),
  paste("apeglm_available", requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE), sep = "\t")
)
writeLines(meta_lines, con = count_file)

print('min_padj', minpadj, 'max_significant_padj', maxsig)

import openpyxl, csv, shutil
stage=Path('galaxy_stage_deseq2')
if stage.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(stage)
stage.mkdir()
# metadata rows
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx', read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws=wb.active
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header=[str(x) if x is not None else '' for x in rows[0]]
idx={name:i for i,name in enumerate(header)}
meta=[]
for r in rows[1:]:
    sample=r[idx['sample']] if idx.get('sample') is not None else None
    if sample:
        meta.append({'sample':str(sample), 'condition':str(r[idx['condition']]), 'sex':str(r[idx['sex']])})
meta_samples=[m['sample'] for m in meta]
# read count matrix header
with open('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt') as f:
    count_header=f.readline().split()
col_index={s:i for i,s in enumerate(count_header)}
missing=[s for s in meta_samples if s not in col_index]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit('metadata samples missing from counts: '+repr(missing))
# sample sheet matching collection identifiers
with open(stage/'sample_sheet.tsv','w', newline='') as out:
    w=csv.writer(out, delimiter='\\t')
    w.writerow(['sample','condition','sex'])
    for m in meta:
        w.writerow([m['sample'], m['condition'], m['sex']])
# per-sample counts
outs={s:open(stage/f'{s}.tsv','w', newline='') for s in meta_samples}
try:
    writers={s:csv.writer(outs[s], delimiter='\\t') for s in meta_samples}
    for s,w in writers.items():
        w.writerow(['Geneid', s])
    with open('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt') as f:
        next(f)
        for line in f:
            parts=line.split()
            gene=parts[0]
            for s,w in writers.items():
                w.writerow([gene, parts[col_index[s]]])
finally:
    for fh in outs.values(): fh.close()
print('staged_files', len(list(stage.glob('*.tsv'))))
print('samples', len(meta_samples), meta_samples)
print('sample_sheet', stage/'sample_sheet.tsv')

from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p='inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx'
ns={'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    shared=[]
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('a:si', ns):
        texts=[]
        for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'):
            texts.append(t.text or '')
        shared.append(''.join(texts))
    sheet=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    rows=[]
    for row in sheet.findall('.//a:sheetData/a:row', ns):
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('a:c', ns):
            r=c.attrib.get('r')
            t=c.attrib.get('t')
            v=c.find('a:v', ns)
            val='' if v is None else v.text
            if t=='s' and val"'!='"'': val=shared[int(val)]
            vals.append((r,val))
        rows.append(vals)
    for vals in rows[:30]:
        print(vals)
PY"

RS"

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design

  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.

representation.name: Codex DESeq2 apeglm sex-adjusted ASXL1 contrast
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected counts and sample metadata paths")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  if (!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The selected BioContainer does not provide the apeglm package")
  }
})

counts_path <- args[[1]]
metadata_path <- args[[2]]

counts_df <- read.table(
  counts_path,
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  sep = "",
  comment.char = "",
  quote = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(counts_df))) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers in count matrix")
counts <- as.matrix(counts_df)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(counts < 0) || any(counts != floor(counts))) {
  stop("Count matrix is not a nonnegative integer matrix")
}
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

metadata <- read.delim(
  metadata_path,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  comment.char = "",
  quote = ""
)
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(metadata))) {
  stop("Metadata must contain sample, condition, and sex columns")
}
metadata <- metadata[!is.na(metadata$sample) & nzchar(metadata$sample), required, drop = FALSE]
metadata$sample <- as.character(metadata$sample)
if (anyDuplicated(metadata$sample)) stop("Duplicate sample identifiers in metadata")
if (any(!metadata$sample %in% colnames(counts))) {
  stop("Metadata sample identifiers are not all present in the count matrix")
}
counts <- counts[, metadata$sample, drop = FALSE]

metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
metadata$sex <- factor(metadata$sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
if (anyNA(metadata$condition) || anyNA(metadata$sex)) {
  stop("Unexpected condition or sex level")
}
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ sex + condition
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

coef_name <- grep("^condition_ASXL1_vs_Control$", resultsNames(dds), value = TRUE)
if (length(coef_name) != 1) {
  stop(paste("Could not identify the ASXL1-vs-Control coefficient:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse = ", ")))
}

res_unshrunk <- results(dds, name = coef_name, alpha = 0.05)
res <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = coef_name,
  type = "apeglm",
  res = res_unshrunk
)

result_df <- data.frame(
  gene_id = rownames(res),
  as.data.frame(res),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(
  result_df,
  file = "deseq2_apeglm_results.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)
RSCRIPT
Rscript --vanilla run_deseq2.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.coldata.path)"

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected counts and sample metadata paths")

job_lib <- file.path(getwd(), "r_lib")
dir.create(job_lib, showWarnings = FALSE)
.libPaths(c(job_lib, .libPaths()))
slots <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("GALAXY_SLOTS", "4")))
if (is.na(slots) || slots < 1) slots <- 4
Sys.setenv(MAKEFLAGS = paste0("-j", slots))
options(timeout = 1200)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  if (!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      c("emdbook", "RcppEigen", "RcppNumerical"),
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org",
      lib = job_lib,
      dependencies = TRUE,
      Ncpus = slots
    )
    install.packages(
      "https://mghp.osn.xsede.org/bir190004-bucket01/archive.bioconductor.org/packages/3.18/bioc/src/contrib/apeglm_1.24.0.tar.gz",
      repos = NULL,
      type = "source",
      lib = job_lib
    )
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Pinned job-local apeglm installation did not succeed")
  }
})

counts_df <- read.table(
  args[[1]], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
  sep = "", comment.char = "", quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(counts_df))) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers in count matrix")
counts <- as.matrix(counts_df)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(counts < 0) || any(counts != floor(counts))) {
  stop("Count matrix is not a nonnegative integer matrix")
}
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

metadata <- read.delim(
  args[[2]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "", quote = ""
)
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(metadata))) stop("Metadata columns missing")
metadata <- metadata[!is.na(metadata$sample) & nzchar(metadata$sample), required, drop = FALSE]
metadata$sample <- as.character(metadata$sample)
if (anyDuplicated(metadata$sample)) stop("Duplicate metadata samples")
if (any(!metadata$sample %in% colnames(counts))) stop("Metadata sample missing from counts")
counts <- counts[, metadata$sample, drop = FALSE]

metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
metadata$sex <- factor(metadata$sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
if (anyNA(metadata$condition) || anyNA(metadata$sex)) stop("Unexpected factor level")
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = metadata, design = ~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
coef_name <- grep("^condition_ASXL1_vs_Control$", resultsNames(dds), value = TRUE)
if (length(coef_name) != 1) stop(paste("Coefficient not found:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse = ", ")))

res_unshrunk <- results(dds, name = coef_name, alpha = 0.05)
res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm", res = res_unshrunk)

result_df <- data.frame(
  gene_id = rownames(res),
  as.data.frame(res),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(
  result_df, file = "deseq2_apeglm_results.tsv", sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA"
)

    print(i, repr(line))
for i,line in enumerate(lines[-5:], start=max(0,len(lines)-5)):
    print(i, repr(line))
# count padj column 6, no header
count=0
nonnum=0
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if not line.strip(): continue
    fields=line.split('\\t')

        print('short line', i, fields)
        continue
    val=fields[5].strip()
    if val == 'NA' or val == '':

    try:

        nonnum+=1
        if nonnum<=5:
            print('bad padj', i, repr(val))
        continue
    if p < 0.05:
        count+=1

import collections

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readxl))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(apeglm))
coldata <- as.data.frame(read_excel('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx'))
# match count cols and order
counts <- read.table('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, sep='')
counts <- counts[, coldata"'$sample, drop=FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts), coldata$sample))
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels=c('"'Control','ASXL1'))
coldata"'$sex <- factor(coldata$sex, levels=c('"'F','M'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=coldata, design=~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
print(resultsNames(dds))
for (alpha in c(0.1,0.05)) {
  res <- results(dds, name='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', alpha=alpha)
  cat('alpha',alpha,'summary\\n'); print(summary(res))
  resL <- lfcShrink(dds, coef='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', res=res, type='apeglm')
  cat('lfc summary\\n'); print(summary(resL))
  cat('count padj <0.05 =', sum(resL"'$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), '"'of', nrow(resL), '\\n')
  cat('count pvalue <0.05 =', sum(res"'$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), '"'\\n')
  cat('NA padj', sum(is.na(resL"'$padj)), '"'NA pvalue', sum(is.na(res"'$pvalue)), '"'\\n')
}
RS"

import bioblend.galaxy
import os
import csv
import io

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)
hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5ec87fbc98a4177fe'

# Upload sample sheet
gi.tools.upload_file('/workspace/downloads/sample_sheet.tsv', 
                      history_id=hist_id, 
                      file_name='sample_sheet.tsv',
                      file_type='tabular')
print("Uploaded sample_sheet.tsv")

# Read count matrix and split into per-sample files
# The count matrix is space-separated
samples = []
with open('/workspace/downloads/counts.txt') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip()
    # Split by whitespace
    header_parts = header.split()
    geneid_col = header_parts[0]
    sample_cols = header_parts[1:]
    print(f"Gene ID column: {geneid_col}")
    print(f"Sample columns ({len(sample_cols)}): {sample_cols}")
    
    # Read all data
    data = {}
    for sample in sample_cols:
        data[sample] = []
    
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        gene_id = parts[0]
        for i, sample in enumerate(sample_cols):
            data[sample].append((gene_id, parts[i+1]))

# Only keep samples that are in the metadata
meta_samples = set()
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/downloads/colData.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if row[0] and row[1]:
        meta_samples.add(row[0])

print(f"Samples with metadata: {len(meta_samples)}")

# Upload per-sample count files for samples with metadata
sample_datasets = {}
for sample in sample_cols:
    if sample not in meta_samples:
        print(f"Skipping {sample} (no metadata)")
        continue
    
    content = f"{geneid_col}\t{sample}\n"
    for gene_id, count in data[sample]:
        content += f"{gene_id}\t{count}\n"
    
    result = gi.tools.upload_file(content.encode('utf-8'),
                                   history_id=hist_id,
                                   file_name=f'{sample}_counts.tsv',
                                   file_type='tabular')
    # Get the dataset ID from result
    if 'outputs' in result:
        ds_id = result['outputs'][0]['id']
    else:
        ds_id = result['id']
    sample_datasets[sample] = ds_id
    print(f"Uploaded {sample}_counts.tsv -> {ds_id}")

print(f"\nUploaded {len(sample_datasets)} sample count files")

# Save sample_datasets mapping for later use
import json
with open('/workspace/downloads/sample_datasets.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(sample_datasets, f)
    
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy
import os
import json
import tempfile

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)
hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5ec87fbc98a4177fe'

# Read count matrix 
samples = []
gene_data = []
with open('/workspace/downloads/counts.txt') as f:
    header_parts = f.readline().strip().split()
    sample_cols = header_parts[1:]
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            parts = line.split()
            gene_id = parts[0]
            counts = parts[1:]
            gene_data.append((gene_id, counts))

# Only keep samples with metadata
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/downloads/colData.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
meta_samples = set()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if row[0] and row[1]:
        meta_samples.add(row[0])

valid_samples = [s for s in sample_cols if s in meta_samples]
print(f"Valid samples: {len(valid_samples)}")

# Upload per-sample count files using temp files
sample_datasets = {}
for sample in valid_samples:
    idx = sample_cols.index(sample)
    
    # Write to temp file
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.tsv', delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(f"Geneid\t{sample}\n")
        for gene_id, counts in gene_data:
            tmp.write(f"{gene_id}\t{counts[idx]}\n")
        tmp_path = tmp.name
    
    result = gi.tools.upload_file(tmp_path, 
                                   history_id=hist_id,
                                   file_name=f'{sample}_counts.tsv',
                                   file_type='tabular')
    os.unlink(tmp_path)
    
    if 'outputs' in result:
        ds_id = result['outputs'][0]['id']
    else:
        ds_id = result['id']
    sample_datasets[sample] = ds_id

print(f"Uploaded {len(sample_datasets)} sample count files")

with open('/workspace/downloads/sample_datasets.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(sample_datasets, f)
print("Saved dataset IDs to sample_datasets.json")

        padj_str = parts[padj_col].strip()
        
        if padj_str == 'NA' or padj_str == '':

            continue

                significant += 1
        except ValueError:
            print(f"Warning: Could not parse padj value: '{padj_str}' in row {total}")

print(f"Total genes: {total}")
print(f"NA padj: {na_count}")
print(f"padj < 0.05: {significant}")

  -H "x-api-key: $GALAXY_API_KEY"

python3 -c "
import zipfile, io
z = zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/coldata.xlsx')
# List contents
for name in z.namelist():
    print(f'File: {name}, Size: {z.getinfo(name).file_size}')
# Read shared strings
shared_strings = []
try:
    with z.open('xl/sharedStrings.xml') as f:
        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
        tree = ET.parse(f)
        root = tree.getroot()
        ns = {'ns': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
        for si in root.findall('.//ns:si', ns):
            text_parts = []
            for t in si.findall('.//ns:t', ns):
                if t.text:
                    text_parts.append(t.text)
            shared_strings.append(''.join(text_parts))
    print('\nShared Strings:', shared_strings[:30])
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error reading shared strings: {e}')

# Read sheet data
try:
    with z.open('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml') as f:
        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
        tree = ET.parse(f)
        root = tree.getroot()
        ns = {'ns': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
        rows = root.findall('.//ns:row', ns)
        print(f'\nTotal rows: {len(rows)}')
        for row in rows[:5]:
            row_num = row.get('r')
            cells = {}
            for cell in row.findall('ns:c', ns):
                ref = cell.get('r')
                cell_type = cell.get('t')
                val_elem = cell.find('ns:v', ns)
                val = val_elem.text if val_elem is not None else ''
                if cell_type == 's' and val:  # Shared string reference
                    val = shared_strings[int(val)]
                cells[ref] = val
            print(f'Row {row_num}:', cells)
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
"

import os

# Read the space-delimited count matrix
all_lines = []
with open('/tmp/count_matrix.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        all_lines.append(line.strip())

header = all_lines[0].split()  # split on whitespace
gene_col = header[0]
samples = header[1:]

print(f"Found {len(samples)} samples: {samples}")

# Parse all data lines
data = {}
for sample in samples:
    data[sample] = []

for line in all_lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) != 22:
        print(f"WARNING: line has {len(parts)} parts, expected 22: {parts[0][:30]}")
        continue
    gene_id = parts[0]
    counts = parts[1:]
    for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
        data[sample].append(f"{gene_id}\t{counts[i]}")

# Write individual tab-delimited files
os.makedirs('/tmp/sample_counts', exist_ok=True)
for sample in samples:
    path = f'/tmp/sample_counts/{sample}.txt'
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(f"Geneid\t{sample}\n")

import os, time
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

with open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)
history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b5bae20868a11cf98f"

sample_dir = "/tmp/sample_counts"
sample_files = sorted(os.listdir(sample_dir))
print(f"Found {len(sample_files)} sample files")

# Upload all files
dataset_ids = {}
for sf in sample_files:
    sample_name = sf.replace('.txt', '')
    file_path = os.path.join(sample_dir, sf)
    result = gi.tools.upload_file(
        file_path,
        history_id=history_id,
        file_name=sample_name,
        file_type="tabular",
        dbkey="?"
    )
    output_id = result['outputs'][0]['id']
    dataset_ids[sample_name] = output_id
    print(f"Uploaded {sample_name} -> {output_id}")

print(f"\nTotal uploaded: {len(dataset_ids)}")
print("Waiting for uploads to complete...")

# Wait for all uploads to finish
max_wait = 120
for i in range(max_wait):
    time.sleep(3)
    all_ok = True
    for sample_name, ds_id in dataset_ids.items():
        ds = gi.datasets.show_dataset(ds_id)
        if ds['state'] not in ('ok', 'error'):
            all_ok = False
            break
    if all_ok:
        print(f"All uploads completed after {i*3}s")
        break
else:
    print("Timeout waiting for uploads")

# Check status
for sample_name, ds_id in dataset_ids.items():
    ds = gi.datasets.show_dataset(ds_id)
    print(f"  {sample_name}: {ds['state']} - {ds.get('file_size', 0)} bytes")

import os, json
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

with open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)
history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b5bae20868a11cf98f"

# The 19 samples that are in the coldata (excluding MGD1640B and MGD1641B)
valid_samples = [
    'MGD1567B', 'MGD1569B', 'MGD1613B', 'MGD1615B', 'MGD1616B',
    'MGD1710B', 'MGD1711B', 'MGD1712B', 'MGD1713B', 'MGD1714B',
    'MGD1715B', 'MGD1722B', 'MGD1723B', 'MGD1724B', 'MGD1727B',
    'MGD1731B', 'MGD1732B', 'MGD1733B', 'MGD1734B'
]

# Maps of sample names to dataset IDs from the uploads
# From the history: the per-sample files are at specific HIDs
# Let me find the dataset IDs for the UPLOADED files (the second set, not the first upload1 ones)
# Looking at the history output: HIDs 29-49 are the files from our BioBlend uploads
sample_dataset_ids = {}
history = gi.histories.show_history(history_id, contents=True)
for ds in history:
    if isinstance(ds, dict) and ds.get('state') == 'ok':
        name = ds.get('name', '')
        if name in valid_samples:
            sample_dataset_ids[name] = ds['id']

print(f"Found {len(sample_dataset_ids)} matching datasets")
# Sort by sample order
sorted_ids = {s: sample_dataset_ids[s] for s in valid_samples if s in sample_dataset_ids}

# Create collection elements
elements = []
for sample_name, ds_id in sorted_ids.items():
    elements.append({
        'src': 'hda',
        'id': ds_id,
        'name': sample_name,
        'tags': []
    })

print(f"Creating collection with {len(elements)} elements")

# Create the collection
result = gi.histories.create_dataset_collection(
    history_id=history_id,
    collection_description={
        'name': "Sample count files (matched)",
        'element_identifiers': elements,
        'collection_type': 'list'
    }
)

print(f"Collection result: {json.dumps(result, indent=2)[:500]}")
if isinstance(result, dict) and 'id' in result:
    print(f"\nCollection ID: {result['id']}")
PYEOF

import csv

# Count genes with padj < 0.05
# Columns: gene_id, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj
total = 0
sig_count = 0
na_count = 0

with open('/tmp/deseq2_results.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        total += 1
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) < 6:
            continue
        padj_str = parts[5]
        if padj_str == 'NA' or padj_str == '' or padj_str.upper() == 'NAN':
            na_count += 1
            continue
        try:
            padj = float(padj_str)
            if padj < 0.05:
                sig_count += 1
        except ValueError:
            na_count += 1

print(f"Total genes (rows): {total}")
print(f"Significant genes (padj < 0.05): {sig_count}")
print(f"NA padj (independent filtering): {na_count}")
print(f"Non-significant (padj >= 0.05): {total - sig_count - na_count}")

# Also check distribution
pvals = []
with open('/tmp/deseq2_results.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        try:
            pvals.append(float(parts[4]))
        except:
            pass

print(f"\nP-value range: {min(pvals):.2e} to {max(pvals):.2e}")
print(f"P-values < 0.05: {sum(1 for p in pvals if p < 0.05)}")

coldata_samples = []

for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if row[0] is not None:
        s = row[0]
        coldata_samples.append(s)
        coldata_info[s] = {'condition': row[1], 'sex': row[2]}

    lines = f.readlines()

header_cols = lines[0].strip().split()
headers = [h for h in header_cols if h.strip()]
print(f'All count columns ({len(headers)-1}): {headers[1:]}')

# Find which columns to keep (only those in coldata)
geneid_idx = 0  # Geneid is first
keep_indices = [geneid_idx]
keep_samples = []
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    if i == 0:
        continue
    if h in coldata_samples:
        keep_indices.append(i)
        keep_samples.append(h)

print(f'Keeping {len(keep_samples)} samples: {keep_samples}')
missing_from_coldata = [h for h in headers[1:] if h not in coldata_samples]
print(f'Dropping {len(missing_from_coldata)}: {missing_from_coldata}')

# Write cleaned tab-delimited file
with open('/workspace/ASXL1_counts_clean.tabular', 'w') as out:
    for line in lines:
        cols = line.strip().split()
        # Keep only selected columns
        kept = [cols[i] for i in keep_indices]
        out.write('\t'.join(kept) + '\n')

print('Written: /workspace/ASXL1_counts_clean.tabular')

import os
import time
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

api_key = open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE','/claude_home/.galaxy/api_key')).read().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', api_key)

hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5d4b6392d4404119c'

# Upload coldata first
print("Uploading coldata...")
coldata = gi.tools.upload_file(
    '/workspace/ASXL1_coldata.tabular',
    history_id=hist_id,
    file_name='ASXL1_coldata',
    file_type='tabular'
)
print(f"Coldata uploaded: {coldata}")

# Upload individual count files
sample_files = sorted(os.listdir('/workspace/sample_counts'))
print(f"Uploading {len(sample_files)} sample count files...")

dataset_ids = {}
for sf in sample_files:
    fpath = f'/workspace/sample_counts/{sf}'
    sample_name = sf.replace('.tabular', '')
    try:
        result = gi.tools.upload_file(
            fpath,
            history_id=hist_id,
            file_name=sf,
            file_type='tabular'
        )
        ds_id = result['outputs'][0]['id']
        dataset_ids[sample_name] = ds_id
        print(f"  {sample_name} -> {ds_id}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error uploading {sf}: {e}")
    time.sleep(0.5)  # Rate limiting

print(f"\nUploaded {len(dataset_ids)} files")
print("Done!")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression: ASXL1 vs Control, controlling for sex, with apeglm LFC shrinkage."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read the count matrix (space-delimited featureCounts output)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_raw = pd.read_csv(
    "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt",
    sep=r"\s+",
    comment="#",
)
print(f"Count matrix raw shape: {counts_raw.shape}")
print(f"Count matrix columns: {list(counts_raw.columns)}")

# Set gene ID as index
counts_raw = counts_raw.set_index("Geneid")
print(f"Count matrix after setting index, shape: {counts_raw.shape}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read coldata (sample metadata)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata_raw = pd.read_excel(
    "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx",
)
# Drop fully empty rows and columns
coldata_raw = coldata_raw.dropna(how="all").dropna(axis=1, how="all")
# Rename first column to 'sample'
coldata_raw.columns = ["sample", "condition", "sex", "age", "SIRE", "Hispanic"]
coldata_raw = coldata_raw.set_index("sample")
print(f"\nColdata shape: {coldata_raw.shape}")
print(coldata_raw)
print(f"\nCondition counts:\n{coldata_raw['condition'].value_counts()}")
print(f"\nSex counts:\n{coldata_raw['sex'].value_counts()}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Align counts and metadata — keep only samples present in both
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
common_samples = sorted(set(counts_raw.columns) & set(coldata_raw.index))
print(f"\nCommon samples ({len(common_samples)}): {common_samples}")

# Report samples in counts but not in coldata
counts_only = set(counts_raw.columns) - set(coldata_raw.index)
coldata_only = set(coldata_raw.index) - set(counts_raw.columns)
print(f"Samples in counts only (will be dropped): {counts_only}")
print(f"Samples in coldata only (will be dropped): {coldata_only}")

counts = counts_raw[common_samples].copy()
coldata = coldata_raw.loc[common_samples].copy()

print(f"\nFinal counts shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"Final coldata shape: {coldata.shape}")

# Ensure counts are integers
counts = counts.astype(int)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare metadata for DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# condition and sex should be categorical; Control is reference level
coldata["condition"] = pd.Categorical(coldata["condition"], categories=["Control", "ASXL1"])
coldata["sex"] = pd.Categorical(coldata["sex"])

print(f"\nColdata dtypes:\n{coldata.dtypes}")
print(f"\nCondition categories: {coldata['condition'].cat.categories}")
print(f"Sex categories: {coldata['sex'].cat.categories}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Running DESeq2 ===")
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=coldata,
    design="~ sex + condition",
    design_factors=["condition", "sex"],
    ref_level=["condition", "Control"],
    n_cpus=1,
)
dds.deseq2()
print("DESeq2 fitting complete.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Extract results for ASXL1 vs Control
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Computing results (ASXL1 vs Control) ===")
stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["condition", "ASXL1", "Control"],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=1,
)
stat_res.summary()
print(f"Results shape before shrinkage: {stat_res.results_df.shape}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Applying apeglm LFC shrinkage ===")
# The coefficient name follows the format: factor_level_vs_reference
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_ASXL1_vs_Control")

results = stat_res.results_df
print(f"Results shape after shrinkage: {results.shape}")
print(f"\nResults columns: {list(results.columns)}")
print(f"\nFirst 10 rows of results:\n{results.head(10)}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Count significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove NA padj values (genes excluded by independent filtering)
results_valid = results.dropna(subset=["padj"])
print(f"\nGenes with non-NA padj: {len(results_valid)}")

sig_genes = results_valid[results_valid["padj"] < 0.05]
print(f"Significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05): {len(sig_genes)}")

# Also report the breakdown
print(f"\npadj distribution (excluding NA):")
print(f"  padj < 0.01: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.01).sum()}")
print(f"  padj < 0.05: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.05).sum()}")
print(f"  padj < 0.10: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.10).sum()}")
print(f"  Total non-NA padj: {len(results_valid)}")

# Write the answer
import os
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(len(sig_genes)) + "\n")
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {len(sig_genes)}")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# DESeq2: ASXL1 mutation vs Control, controlling for sex, apeglm LFC shrinkage

library(DESeq2)
library(apeglm)
library(readxl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read count matrix (space-delimited featureCounts output)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_raw <- read.table(
  "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
cat("Count matrix raw dimensions:", dim(counts_raw), "\n")
cat("Count matrix columns:", head(colnames(counts_raw)), "...\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read coldata
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata_raw <- read_excel("inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx")
coldata_raw <- as.data.frame(coldata_raw)
# Remove empty rows and the extra NA column
coldata_raw <- coldata_raw[!is.na(coldata_raw[,1]), ]
coldata_raw <- coldata_raw[, 1:6]
colnames(coldata_raw) <- c("sample", "condition", "sex", "age", "SIRE", "Hispanic")
rownames(coldata_raw) <- coldata_raw$sample
cat("\nColdata dimensions:", dim(coldata_raw), "\n")
print(coldata_raw)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Align counts and metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts_raw), rownames(coldata_raw))
cat("\nCommon samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

counts_only <- setdiff(colnames(counts_raw), rownames(coldata_raw))
coldata_only <- setdiff(rownames(coldata_raw), colnames(counts_raw))
cat("Dropped from counts (no metadata):", counts_only, "\n")
cat("Dropped from coldata (no counts):", coldata_only, "\n")

counts <- counts_raw[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata_raw[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nFinal counts dimensions:", dim(counts), "\n")
cat("Final coldata dimensions:", dim(coldata), "\n")

# Ensure counts are integers
counts <- round(as.matrix(counts))
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Set up factors
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
coldata$sex <- factor(coldata$sex)

cat("\nCondition levels:", levels(coldata$condition), "\n")
cat("Sex levels:", levels(coldata$sex), "\n")
cat("\nCondition table:\n")
print(table(coldata$condition))
cat("\nSex table:\n")
print(table(coldata$sex))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Running DESeq2 ===\n")
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ sex + condition
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
cat("DESeq2 fitting complete.\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Results for ASXL1 vs Control
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Computing results (ASXL1 vs Control) ===\n")
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"), alpha = 0.05)
cat("Results dimensions:", dim(res), "\n")

# Summary before shrinkage
cat("\nSummary before shrinkage:\n")
print(summary(res))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Applying apeglm LFC shrinkage ===\n")
# The coefficient name in DESeq2: condition_ASXL1_vs_Control
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_ASXL1_vs_Control", type = "apeglm")
cat("Shrinkage complete.\n")

cat("\nSummary after shrinkage:\n")
print(summary(res_shrunk))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Count significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove NA padj values
res_shrunk_valid <- res_shrunk[!is.na(res_shrunk$padj), ]
cat("\nGenes with non-NA padj:", nrow(res_shrunk_valid), "\n")

sig_genes <- res_shrunk_valid[res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.05, ]
cat("Significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_genes), "\n")

# Detailed breakdown
cat("\npadj distribution (excluding NA):\n")
cat("  padj < 0.01:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  padj < 0.05:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  padj < 0.10:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Total non-NA padj:", nrow(res_shrunk_valid), "\n")

# Write answer
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(nrow(sig_genes)), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt:", nrow(sig_genes), "\n")

parameters.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DESeq2 differential expression analysis with apeglm LFC shrinkage.
Comparison: ASXL1 mutation vs Control, controlling for sex.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# ---- 1. Read sample metadata (coldata) ----
coldata = pd.read_excel(
    'inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx',
    sheet_name='Sheet1'
)
coldata = coldata.dropna(subset=['sample'])  # drop empty rows
coldata = coldata.set_index('sample')
print("Coldata shape:", coldata.shape)
print("Condition counts:", coldata['condition'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Sex counts:", coldata['sex'].value_counts().to_dict())

# ---- 2. Read count matrix ----
# featureCounts output: header row uses spaces, data rows use tabs.
# Read the header separately.
with open('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', 'r') as f:
    header_line = f.readline().strip()

# Parse header: first token is "Geneid", rest are sample names
header_parts = header_line.split()
sample_cols = header_parts[1:]  # skip "Geneid"

print(f"Number of sample columns in count matrix: {len(sample_cols)}")

# Read data with pandas, using the header line
# The data rows are tab-separated. The header line is space-separated,
# so we use read_csv with sep='\t' but skip the header row.
counts = pd.read_csv(
    'inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt',
    sep='\t',
    skiprows=1,
    header=None,
    names=header_parts
)
counts = counts.set_index('Geneid')
print("Count matrix shape:", counts.shape)
print("First few gene IDs:", counts.index[:5].tolist())

# ---- 3. Filter to samples present in coldata ----
common_samples = sorted(set(counts.columns) & set(coldata.index))
print(f"Samples in coldata: {len(coldata)}")
print(f"Samples in count matrix: {counts.shape[1]}")
print(f"Common samples: {len(common_samples)}")

# Samples in count matrix but not in coldata
extra = set(counts.columns) - set(coldata.index)
if extra:
    print(f"Excluding samples not in coldata: {sorted(extra)}")

# Samples in coldata but not in count matrix
missing = set(coldata.index) - set(counts.columns)
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: samples in coldata but not in count matrix: {sorted(missing)}")

# Keep only common samples
counts = counts[common_samples]
coldata = coldata.loc[common_samples]

print(f"After filtering - counts: {counts.shape}, coldata: {coldata.shape}")
print("Condition distribution:", coldata['condition'].value_counts().to_dict())

# ---- 4. Prepare factors ----
# condition should be 'ASXL1' vs 'Control', with Control as reference
coldata['condition'] = pd.Categorical(
    coldata['condition'],
    categories=['Control', 'ASXL1']
)
coldata['sex'] = pd.Categorical(coldata['sex'])

# ---- 5. Create DESeq2 dataset and run analysis ----
print("\n=== Running DESeq2 ===")
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts.T,  # PyDESeq2 expects samples x genes
    metadata=coldata,
    design='~ condition + sex',
    quiet=False
)

# Filter genes with very low counts (DESeq2 internal filtering)
# PyDESeq2 applies independent filtering during statistical testing
dds.deseq2()

print("DESeq2 complete.")
print(f"Dispersions computed for {dds.n_vars} genes")

# ---- 6. Extract results for the ASXL1 vs Control contrast ----
# The contrast is condition_ASXL1_vs_Control
print("\n=== Running statistical testing ===")
stat_results = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=['condition', 'ASXL1', 'Control'],
    alpha=0.05,
    quiet=False
)

stat_results.summary()
print(f"Results summary complete.")

# ---- 7. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage ----
print("\n=== Applying apeglm LFC shrinkage ===")
stat_results.lfc_shrink(coeff='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', adapt=True)
print("LFC shrinkage complete.")

# ---- 8. Get results table ----
res = stat_results.results_df
print(f"\nResults table shape: {res.shape}")
print("Columns:", res.columns.tolist())
print("padj summary:")
print(res['padj'].describe())

# ---- 9. Count significantly differentially expressed genes (padj < 0.05) ----
sig_genes = res[res['padj'] < 0.05]
n_sig = len(sig_genes)
print(f"\n=== Number of significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05): {n_sig} ===")
print(f"  Upregulated (log2FoldChange > 0): {(sig_genes['log2FoldChange'] > 0).sum()}")
print(f"  Downregulated (log2FoldChange < 0): {(sig_genes['log2FoldChange'] < 0).sum()}")

# Check for NA padj values
na_padj = res['padj'].isna().sum()
print(f"  Genes with NA padj: {na_padj}")

# ---- 10. Write answer ----
with open('codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(n_sig) + '\n')

print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {n_sig}")

parameters.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DESeq2 differential expression analysis with apeglm LFC shrinkage
ASXL1 mutation vs Control, controlling for sex.
"""

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/python_pkgs')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from pydeseq2.utils import load_example_data

# ----- 1. Load data -----
print("Loading coldata...")
coldata = pd.read_excel('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx')
coldata = coldata.set_index('sample')

# Ensure condition is a factor with Control as reference
coldata['condition'] = pd.Categorical(coldata['condition'], categories=['Control', 'ASXL1'])
coldata['sex'] = pd.Categorical(coldata['sex'])

print(f"Coldata shape: {coldata.shape}")
print(coldata.head())
print()

print("Loading count matrix...")
# FeatureCounts output: space-separated, first column is Geneid
counts = pd.read_csv(
    'inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt',
    sep=r'\s+',  # one or more spaces
    index_col=0
)

print(f"Count matrix shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"First 3 index values: {counts.index[:3].tolist()}")
print(f"First 5 columns: {counts.columns[:5].tolist()}")
print()

# ----- 2. Match samples between count matrix and coldata -----
# Find common samples
common_samples = sorted(set(counts.columns) & set(coldata.index))
print(f"Common samples between counts and coldata: {len(common_samples)}")
print(f"Count matrix samples: {sorted(counts.columns.tolist())}")
print(f"Coldata samples: {sorted(coldata.index.tolist())}")

# Samples in counts but not in coldata
extra_in_counts = set(counts.columns) - set(coldata.index)
if extra_in_counts:
    print(f"Samples in counts but NOT in coldata (will be excluded): {extra_in_counts}")

# Samples in coldata but not in counts
extra_in_coldata = set(coldata.index) - set(counts.columns)
if extra_in_coldata:
    print(f"Samples in coldata but NOT in counts (will be excluded): {extra_in_coldata}")

# Subset to common samples
counts = counts[common_samples]
coldata = coldata.loc[common_samples]

# Ensure same order
counts = counts[coldata.index.tolist()]

print(f"\nAfter matching: {len(common_samples)} samples")
print(f"Counts shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"Coldata shape: {coldata.shape}")
print()

# ----- 3. Run DESeq2 -----
print("Running DESeq2...")
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=coldata,
    design_factors="sex + condition",  # control for sex
    refit_cooks=True
)

# Filter low-count genes (DESeq2 default-like)
# Remove genes with very low counts
dds.deseq2()

print("DESeq2 fitting complete.")

# ----- 4. Statistical results for condition_ASXL1_vs_Control -----
print("\nExtracting results for ASXL1 vs Control...")
stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["condition", "ASXL1", "Control"],
    alpha=0.05,
    cooks_filter=True,
    independent_filter=True,
)

# Run the statistical test
stat_res.summary()

print(f"Results shape: {stat_res.results_df.shape}")

# ----- 5. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage -----
print("\nApplying apeglm LFC shrinkage...")
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_ASXL1_vs_Control", method="apeglm")

# Get the final results
res = stat_res.results_df.copy()
print(f"Final results shape: {res.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {res.columns.tolist()}")

# ----- 6. Count significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05) -----
sig_genes = res[res['padj'] < 0.05]
n_sig = len(sig_genes)
print(f"\nNumber of significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05): {n_sig}")

# Also show breakdown
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(res)}")
print(f"padj < 0.05: {n_sig}")
print(f"padj < 0.01: {len(res[res['padj'] < 0.01])}")
print(f"padj < 0.1: {len(res[res['padj'] < 0.1])}")

# Show top DE genes
print("\nTop 10 DE genes by adjusted p-value:")
top = res.nsmallest(10, 'padj')
for gene, row in top.iterrows():
    print(f"  {gene}: log2FC={row['log2FoldChange']:.3f}, padj={row['padj']:.2e}")

# Save the answer
import os
os.makedirs('codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{n_sig}\n")

print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {n_sig}")

LFC shrinkage with an apeGLM prior :cite:p:`DeseqStats-zhu2019heavy`.

Shrinks LFCs using a heavy-tailed Cauchy prior, leaving p-values unchanged.

Parameters
----------
coeff : str
    The LFC coefficient to shrink. Must be one of the columns of the LFC matrix.
    (default: ``None``).

adapt: bool
    Whether to use the MLE estimates of LFC to adapt the prior. If False, the
    prior scale is set to 1. (``default=True``)
